units.source_text: 我等会员与赫卟夫人静静地坐在圆桌四周。

en.t: We members sat quietly around the round table with Mrs. Hepp.

units.source_text: 三分二十五秒以后，夫人突然陷入非常激烈的梦游状态，

en.t: After three minutes and twenty-five seconds, the lady suddenly fell into a very violent state of somnambulism,

units.source_text: 并且被诗人托喀君的灵魂附体。

en.t: and she was possessed by the soul of Toka, the poet.

units.source_text: 我等会员以年龄为顺序，

en.t: We members, in order of age,

units.source_text: 和附体在夫人身上的托喀君的魂灵对话如下：

en.t: held the following dialogue with the spirit of Toka, who had possessed the lady:
